startingEnvelope.applicationAuthentication: Preview HMAC authentication intentionally disabled in production

RC3-AUTH-001.finding: A fail-closed RS256 OIDC/JWKS production verifier and environment-aware application auth boundary exist and are covered by adversarial unit tests. OIDC establishes external identity only; application authority is resolved separately. Production runtime identity configuration and deployed success/failure evidence are still required before closure.

RC3-BIND-001.finding: Server-side application identity binding now resolves verified (issuer, subject) to canonical participant_id and governed application scopes, with durable uniqueness preventing silent rebinding. Production-capable read routes consume the canonical principal. Consequential sandbox mutation routes now use environment-neutral generated durable identifiers/runtime metadata but remain explicitly production-disabled. Runtime proof of bound, unbound, disabled and cross-role principals is still required before closure.

RC3-ENV-001.finding: Exact-head Vercel deployment is now mandatory in constitutional conformance, and a dedicated RC3 production identity rehearsal workflow accepts an explicit Production origin and exact deployed SHA. Production issuer, audience, JWKS and application-binding configuration still require a successful deployed rehearsal before closure.

RC3-LOG-001.finding: Production identity runtime logging hygiene has not yet been falsified with real production-auth failure/success traffic.

RC3-PAY-001.finding: Paystack authenticity/replay semantics are proven in test mode only. Live provider activation and live funds remain unauthorized.

RC3-ROLLBACK-001.finding: No exact production-auth/provider activation rollback or kill-switch rehearsal has yet been recorded. Existing sandbox mutation kill-switches remain production-disabled and are asserted by the RC3 production identity rehearsal harness, but production identity configuration rollback itself is not yet proven.

RC3-REHEARSAL-001.finding: A dedicated exact-SHA production identity adversarial rehearsal harness and workflow now exist. It tests unauthenticated and malformed denial, cross-role escalation denial, server-side canonical actor binding and production mutation kill-switches without authorizing live funds. The blocker remains open until the workflow passes against an exact Production deployment.
